# Petstore fixture

`openapi.json` is the Swagger Petstore OpenAPI 3.0 specification, downloaded unmodified from
<https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/openapi.json> on 2026-11-23. The Swagger Petstore sample is
published by SmartBear under the Apache License 2.0. It is used here only as test input; the
tests do not call the live service.
